description: The ltstrange satellite-simulator repository supplies a Rust and Bevy application for visualising low-Earth-orbit constellations and their connectivity. Users define satellites and orbits in JSON and set link range, connection limits and time scaling through TOML configuration. The application displays the constellation in three dimensions and exposes network-query operations. Coverage is global orbital space, not a terrestrial observation dataset; temporal detail and constellation size follow the configuration. Public source and build/run instructions are free under MIT. A limitation is that delay and interference modelling, energy use and computation offloading appear as future work, while Python bindings are described as in progress. The README's throughput claim was not benchmarked in this review and is not treated as verified capacity. The current resource can prepare or explore connectivity scenarios for satellite communication infrastructure, complementary to the catalogue's ns-3 platform (platform-ns-3). It should not be treated as a validated end-to-end communications or orbital-prediction system. No constellation data or executable was downloaded.
name: LEO satellite constellation connectivity simulator
